intro: Unending Torment is a task undertaken on behalf of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity. An emissary confronts a defiant captive or subject who refuses to cooperate, calling the petitioner an abomination. Reporting this defiance back to Master Apothecary Faranell elicits satisfaction rather than disappointment, as the apothecary leader relishes the opportunity to break a difficult subject.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.
